name: SB Network Hub
description:
SB Network is a Minecraft Bedrock network built around competitive PvP and a high-quality multiplayer experience.

⚔️ **SB Practice**

Test your skills across a wide range of PvP modes, including Ranked & Unranked Duels, FFA, Boxing, Nodebuff, BUHC, Sumo, Gapple, Combo, Classic, Crystal and more.

🏆 **Competitive Progression**

Climb the global ELO leaderboards, track your stats, compete against other players and prove yourself across multiple kits.

👥 **Play With Others**

Create parties, challenge other players, join clans and compete alongside your friends.

🌍 **SB Survival**

Explore our Survival experience featuring an economy, player vaults, bounties, leaderboards, homes, trading systems and custom quality-of-life features.

✨ **Network Features**

• Ranked & Unranked PvP

• Global leaderboards

• Parties & 2v2 battles

• Clans

• Player profiles & statistics

• Cosmetics & trails

• Custom Survival economy

• Bounties & vaults

• Active development and regular updates

• Designed specifically for Minecraft Bedrock Edition

Whether you're looking to grind ranked PvP, improve your mechanics, compete with friends or enjoy Survival, SB Network has something for you.

**Port:** 19132

**Website:** sbpvp.com

Join SB Network and start climbing.
